result.markdown:
# Fiber Link Outage Causes S-SAH-002 Site Down

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SAH-01-A`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence on the transport link, matching site outage timing, and confirmed absence of changes or maintenance.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-29 05:00 to 2026-09-29 08:11
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-29 05:03
- **Affected:** S-SAH-002, S-SAH-004, S-SAH-012

## Summary

A fiber transport link loss of signal (LINK_LOS) severed connectivity for S-SAH-002 and its sibling sites.

S-SAH-002 experienced a site outage from 05:00 to 08:11 due to a transport fiber link failure.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-29 05:00: Anomaly detected on S-SAH-002 affecting availability, active users, and traffic volume. [T1, ANM-000472]
- 2026-09-29 05:03: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on transport link LNK-SAH-01-A. [T3, ALM-000589]
- 2026-09-29 05:04: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SAH-002, S-SAH-004, and S-SAH-012. [T3, ALM-000590, ALM-000591, ALM-000592]
- 2026-09-29 08:08: LINK_LOS alarm cleared on LNK-SAH-01-A indicating link restoration. [ALM-000589]
- 2026-09-29 08:11: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on S-SAH-002 and S-SAH-004 as service recovered. [ALM-000590, ALM-000592]

## Evidence

- S-SAH-002 depends on fiber link LNK-SAH-01-A, aggregate router AGG-SAH-01, and core upf CORE-UPF-01. [T2]
- A critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on LNK-SAH-01-A at 2026-09-29 05:03. [T3, ALM-000589]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms affected S-SAH-002, S-SAH-004, and S-SAH-012 simultaneously. [T3, ALM-000590, ALM-000591, ALM-000592]
- No changes were executed on the affected nodes and ancestors between 03:05 and 08:17. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes and ancestors between 03:05 and 08:17. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-01-A: confirmed. LINK_LOS on LNK-SAH-01-A directly caused simultaneous site down alarms on all connected sites. [T3, ALM-000589]
2. **power_failure** at S-SAH-003: rejected. Mains failure on S-SAH-003 was isolated and cleared earlier without impacting S-SAH-002 topology. [T6, ALM-000584]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000584: Mains failure occurred on unrelated site S-SAH-003 and did not affect S-SAH-002.
- T4: No configuration changes were made on any affected node or ancestor during the incident window.
- T5: No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes during the incident timeframe.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect physical fiber link LNK-SAH-01-A for potential cuts or damage.
- Review transport link telemetry logs for recurring signal losses.
